chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

Do not perform salat (prayer) in a house in which there is wine or an intoxicant, because the angels do not enter it. And do not perform salat (prayer) in a garment that wine or an intoxicant has touched until you wash it.
ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat (prayer) in a house or garment affected by wine or intoxicants?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) in relation to wine and intoxicants. It prohibits praying in a house containing wine or an intoxicant, and it also prohibits praying in a garment contaminated by them until it is washed.
